# zerops_service_backup_config (Resource)

Owns backup scheduling and custom retention for a backup-capable managed service. Delete disables the schedule and clears the custom retention policy, falling back to server defaults; it never deletes backup files or the service. This resource does not create or restore backups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zerops_service_backup_config" "cache" {
  service_id    = zerops_service.cache.id # A backup-capable managed service, e.g. valkey:single@7.2.
  backup_period = "15 3 * * *"

  retention_policy {
    max_total_files = 10
    max_total_gib   = 2
    protected_tags  = ["daily"]
    min_daily       = 1
    max_daily       = 3
    min_weekly      = 1
    max_weekly      = 2
    min_monthly     = 1
    max_monthly     = 2
  }
}

# Removing backup_period disables scheduling. Removing retention_policy falls
# back to the platform defaults exposed as default_retention_policy.
# Destroy resets both settings; existing backups and the service are not deleted.
```

## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String)

### Optional

- `backup_period` (String) Five-field cron schedule (minute precision); null disables scheduling.
- `retention_policy` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--retention_policy))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `default_retention_policy` (Attributes) Current server defaults; never hardcoded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_retention_policy))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import the existing backup configuration by managed service ID.
terraform import zerops_service_backup_config.cache SERVICE_ID
```
